caption: The drawing depicts two distinct objects on a neutral, beige background: an earthenware cup and an octagonal saucer or shallow bowl. The cup, located at the top, has a round shape with a handle on the right side and features a brown interior and rim. The exterior is decorated with abstract, swirling patterns in brown, green, and ochre tones. Below the cup, the octagonal saucer or bowl displays a decorative floral design in the center, with prominent orange-brown, green, and dark brown hues. The floral motif includes symmetrical petals with accented dark stripes and side leaves. There are hints of green splashes dotting the surrounding surface, and the number "1829" is visible on the left side along the border. Both objects are rendered with careful shading and color detailing to create a three-dimensional effect.
title: Pa. German Cup and Saucer
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
